items.text: Real journal pages for books: a review page per book with title, author, dates, format, star rating, thoughts, a favorite quote and a one-line verdict, plus quote and notes pages.
One PDF that works in Goodnotes (named first in the title and listing), Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf on iPad, Android and Windows tablets.
The tracking set reading buyers search for: a book log (the Library), a to-be-read list, monthly reading pages and a yearly reading goal page.
Fully hyperlinked: Contents page, month tabs on every page, a top bar (Home, Library, TBR, Quotes), and previous and next arrows on every book page.
A finished, designed look with real typography and consistent spacing; design is the third biggest praise driver.
Instructions printed inside the file (Start here and Setup check pages), not only in a separate PDF or video.

complaint:c_download: Ships as one PDF, not a zip, with no sticker files that can fail to import. Listing copy and photo 4 give the download in 3 steps: buy, download from Etsy in a web browser (the Etsy app cannot download digital files), open the PDF in a note app. The Start here page repeats the steps for anyone who opened it on a computer first. The cover title matches the listing title exactly, so buyers know they got the right file.

complaint:c_setup: The cover's Open journal button lands on Start here: 4 numbered steps (open it in a note app, check the links, add your first book, start in any month), each with a Go there button. The Setup check page is next. Both are the first two cards on Contents.

complaint:c_not_useful: It keeps history and plans forward, the two things a 1-star buyer missed: 100 numbered book pages that stay filled in, a 12-month set of reading pages and a TBR list for what comes next. Undated, so it starts the day you buy it and nothing is wasted. The listing lists every page type with counts so buyers who need only a few pages can see that before buying.

complaint:c_hard: One review page layout for every book, so there is one page to learn. The Library is the only starting point a reader needs: write the title on a line, tap its number, fill in the book page, tap Library in the trail to go back. Start here step 3 walks through exactly this.

complaint:c_device: Portrait pages at 768 x 1024 (the iPad's own shape held upright, like a book), and every link is a plain PDF link that all major note apps follow. The listing has a Works with / Not for box: works in Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf on iPad, Android and Windows tablets; not made for phones, not a spreadsheet, not a fillable form. The Setup check page proves it on the buyer's own device in one minute.

complaint:c_quality: Every printed word on every page type is spell-checked before publishing, and the build checks 0 broken links, no unreachable pages and no overflowing text. All text is vector so it stays crisp at any zoom. Book pages run in number order, 1 to 100, each exactly once.

complaint:c_misleading: Every listing photo is a screenshot of the built file captioned with the page name; nothing is shown that the file lacks. The description says plainly: digital PDF for note apps, portrait only, undated, no stickers, handwrite or use the app's text tool.

complaint:c_value: Room for 100 books (the capacity a repeat buyer asked for), each with its own full page, plus 12 monthly pages, a yearly goal page, TBR, quotes and notes. Photo 2 shows the top of a book page close up, at reading size, so buyers can judge the writing space before buying. The listing gives the exact page count.

complaint:c_edit: Nothing is locked into the reader's choices: the Library has a blank Shelf column for the reader's own genres or shelves, the book page's Genre is write-in and Format has Print, Ebook and Audio to tick plus a blank to write any other format, and months are undated. The Start here tip and listing say how to type instead of handwrite (the app's text tool, any font the app has). The listing says it is not a fillable form, so nobody expects drop-downs.
complaint:c_broken: The Setup check page: tap three buttons, and if one does not jump, a four-item fix list right there (pen off, open in a note app, re-import as PDF, then message the shop).

complaint:c_support: Most messages are 'it does not work' questions, so the answers are in the file and the listing: the Setup check fix list, the Start here steps, and a listing FAQ with the top five problems (Etsy app download, which app, links not tapping, how to type, portrait only). How fast the shop replies is shop-level (Darren's Etsy inbox), not something the file can fix, and the file promises no reply times (style rule r007).

complaint:c_missing: No promised extras that can go missing: no stickers or covers are advertised, and the listing lists each page type with its count (from the built file, style rule r003). The Contents page shows every section on one screen so nothing is hard to find.

100-book linked Library: Four Library pages with 25 numbered lines each (title, author, finished, stars, shelf). Tap a line's number to open that book's own review page; the page's trail goes back to the right Library page, and arrows step to the previous and next book.

Five-minute start and setup check: Start here is page 3 and Setup check is page 4: four numbered steps with Go there buttons, then buttons that jump and return, with a fix list if they do not. The cover's Open journal button lands on Start here.

Reading year goal page: One page: set a goal in books, color one square per finished book in a row for each month (each month name links to its page), tally formats and fiction or nonfiction, and list a top 5 of the year.

A quiet library, not boho beige and not old paper texture. Warm ivory paper (not white, so it glows less in a dark room) with deep ink-blue text at about 12:1 contrast so it stays sharp in daylight; muted text stays above 4.5:1. One oxblood accent for buttons and star outlines, with a small brass detail on the Contents and guide pages. Month tabs run from dusty clay to soft blue with dark ink labels. Two fonts only: Baskerville for headings and, in italic, for field labels; Manrope for body text, with bold for buttons and tabs. No letter-spaced all-caps labels, so the pages read calm and easy on the eyes. Plain ruled decoration (motif 'lines'): no florals, no clip-art book stacks, no script fonts.
